sources.source: Optional existing local diffusion checkpoint to reuse without training. Requires the diffusion generator and its expected SHA-256. The saved architecture, channels, preprocessing, classifier and condition identities must match the current run. Missing, legacy or incompatible metadata is refused; spaCR does not train a replacement. Blank keeps the existing training route. Default blank.

Expected 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 of the selected local diffusion checkpoint. Required when a checkpoint is selected; ignored when the checkpoint path is blank. A matching checksum identifies the file but does not establish biological accuracy or independent validation. Default blank.
